Border Reveal

An inset border fades and scales into view on hover/focus, framing the image.

Hover or focus the image to see the effect.

HTML

CSS

.hover-effect.border-reveal{
  position: relative;
  display: block;
}
.hover-effect.border-reveal::before{
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 12px;
  border: 2px solid #2563eb;
  border-radius: 4px;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(0.85);
  transition: opacity 0.4s ease, transform 0.4s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.hover-effect.border-reveal:hover::before,
.hover-effect.border-reveal:focus-visible::before{
  opacity: 1;
  transform: scale(1);
}

The ::before pseudo-element fades in and scales from 0.85 to 1 on hover/focus, revealing an inset border. Select the code and copy with Ctrl+C or ⌘C.
